core.title: Trust Cascade through Provenance Erasure: How Multi-Agent Delegation Breaks Single-Agent Safety
core.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems delegate through natural language, creating trust boundaries that single-agent safety hierarchies were not designed to preserve. We identify provenance erasure as a multi-agent safety failure mechanism: even in the minimal two-agent case, delegation strips trust metadata—98% of format markers, 100% of authority entities, and 44% of source attribution across 460 pairs—while often preserving the actionable payload. This lossy transform enables Trust Cascade, amplifying system-channel attacks from 0% to 33–63% cascade ASR across eight open-weight models; a delegation-as-user control isolates channel trust escalation rather than content reformulation. Because the failure occurs at the delegation boundary, we propose the Trust Boundary Auditor (TBA), a zero-inference provenance diagnostic achieving 86–100% conditional detection with 0% false positives across four domains. Training, scale, and closed-source evaluations show that stronger models can interrupt different cascade stages but do not remove the boundary problem, suggesting that multi-agent safety requires delegation gating plus provenance auditing.

article.lead: 多智能体通过自然语言委派任务时，信息来源与权限可能在传递中丢失。本文从委派边界切入，揭示这种损失如何放大安全攻击，并讨论来源审计的价值。

sections.title: 任务委派为何形成新的信任边界
paragraphs: 单智能体安全层级并非为保护多智能体之间的信任边界而设计。任务经自然语言转交时，接收方看到的内容可能保留了可执行的指令，却不再完整携带其来源和权限信息。
摘要将这一机制称为**来源擦除**：问题不只是内容发生改写，还在于内容跨越委派边界后，原有的信任信息可能不再可见。

sections.title: 从双智能体委派到边界审计
paragraphs: 研究考察了最简双智能体委派中的信任元数据损失，并通过将委派内容作为用户消息的对照，区分通道信任升级与内容重新表述的作用。
针对委派边界处的失效，作者提出信任边界审计器（TBA），将其作为无需推理的来源诊断方法。摘要没有展开该审计器的具体实现。

sections.title: 来源擦除与信任级联的报告结果
paragraphs: 在 460 对数据中，委派过程剥离了 98% 的格式标记、100% 的权威实体和 44% 的来源归属，同时往往保留可执行的载荷。摘要据此指出，有损传递使“信任级联”成为可能。
在八个开放权重模型上，系统通道攻击从 0% 放大至 33–63% 的级联攻击成功率。将委派内容作为用户消息的对照表明，关键作用来自通道信任升级，而非内容重新表述。
TBA 在四个领域取得 86–100% 的条件检测率，误报率为 0%。训练、规模和闭源评估还显示，更强模型能够中断级联的不同阶段，但并未消除边界问题。

core.title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
core.abstract: Personalized large language models adapt responses to users’ preferences and social attributes, but can introduce substantial universal truth inconsistencies across social groups, where some groups systematically receive less accurate responses on objective tasks. Existing alignment methods either ignore personalization or mainly focus on subjective preference alignment, largely overlooking fairness and consistency in universal truths. To address this gap, we study Truth-Invariant Alignment (TIA), an alignment problem for personalized LLMs that aims to ensure universal truths remain consistent across social groups while preserving personalization. We propose TriAlign, the first offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for TIA, where each social group is modeled as an agent interacting. TriAlign jointly optimizes universal truth accuracy, cross-group truth consistency, and personalization through a fairness-aware objective and an explicit inconsistency penalty. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TriAlign achieves a stronger balance among these three objectives than strong baselines, reducing universal truth disparities across social groups while improving both objective task performance and personalization quality.

sections.title: 个性化回答为何需要关注事实一致性
paragraphs: 个性化大语言模型会根据用户偏好和社会属性调整回答，但在客观任务中，不同社会群体收到的回答可能出现明显的事实不一致，部分群体还可能系统性地得到准确度更低的回答。

core.title: TRACES: Proactive Safety Auditing for Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Trajectory-State Modeling
core.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate through multi-turn tool use and environment interaction, where safety risks often emerge from intermediate steps long before they surface in the final outcome. Reactive auditing is therefore insufficient: post-hoc diagnosis frequently misses the chance to flag risks while they are unfolding. We propose TRACES, a representation-based proactive auditor that learns prefix-level trajectory risk states from the hidden representations of an observer LLM. TRACES induces latent mechanism features from step representations and models their temporal evolution to estimate whether a partial trajectory is drifting toward unsafe behavior. To sidestep the cost and ambiguity of step-level risk annotation, TRACES is trained with weak trajectory-level supervision while still producing dense prefix-level risk estimates. Across multiple agent safety benchmarks, TRACES improves both full-trajectory safety prediction and proactive risk discrimination. Our analyses further suggest that these risk states can help train a safer agent, highlighting the broader potential of proactive auditing for long-horizon agent safety. The code is available at https://github.com/lab-flair/TRACES.

core.title_zh: TRACES：基于轨迹状态建模的多轮大语言模型智能体主动安全审计

article.lead: 大语言模型智能体在多轮调用工具、与环境交互时，风险可能早在最终结果出现之前就已形成。TRACES 尝试识别执行过程中的风险变化，为理解智能体的主动安全审计提供了一种思路。

sections.title: 安全风险为何需要在轨迹中识别
paragraphs: 智能体的行为不是一次性输出，而可能由多轮工具调用和环境交互组成。摘要指出，危险信号常常出现在中间步骤，等到最终结果显现后再进行事后诊断，可能已经错过风险发展过程中的提示时机。
这一问题的关注点因此从“最终是否安全”，扩展到“尚未完成的行为轨迹是否正在偏离安全方向”。及早识别并不等同于已经阻止风险，但可以为主动审计提供判断依据。

sections.title: 从观察者表征学习轨迹风险状态
paragraphs: TRACES 是一种基于表征的主动审计器。它利用观察者大语言模型的隐藏表征学习轨迹前缀的风险状态：从各步骤的表征中归纳潜在机制特征，再对这些特征随时间的演化进行建模，以估计部分轨迹是否正在趋向不安全行为。
逐步标注风险可能带来成本与判断歧义。为绕开这一困难，TRACES 使用轨迹级弱监督进行训练，同时输出密集的前缀级风险估计。摘要没有展开观察者模型或训练过程的具体配置。

sections.title: 轨迹预测与主动风险辨别的摘要结果
paragraphs: 摘要报告，在多个智能体安全基准上，TRACES 同时改善了完整轨迹的安全预测和主动风险辨别。这说明作者考察的不只是执行结束后的判断，也包括风险尚在发展时的辨别能力；但摘要未给出具体提升幅度。
作者的分析还表明，这些风险状态可能有助于训练更安全的智能体。这是一项值得关注的潜在用途，但摘要将其表述为分析所支持的可能性，不能据此认定它已经在所有长程任务中得到验证。

sections.title: 摘要尚不足以判断的验证范围
paragraphs: 摘要没有说明各基准的样本规模、任务构成和具体比较对象，也没有提供性能指标、结果数值或不确定性信息。因此，仅凭当前资料无法判断改善的幅度、适用边界或相对不同审计方法的表现。
对于更安全智能体的训练，摘要也未交代具体训练设置与验证范围。这里的缺失仅指摘要未报告，并不意味着论文没有进行相关实验或讨论。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注风险状态如何支撑早期判断
paragraphs: 阅读启发：关注大语言模型智能体安全的读者，可进一步查阅论文如何定义轨迹前缀和风险状态，以及弱轨迹级监督如何支撑过程中的风险估计。这有助于理解其主动审计结论的适用条件。

core.title: TraceProbe: An Execution-Based Benchmark for Diagnosing Safety Failures in LLM Agents
core.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly act through files, tools, memory, retrieved content, and other agents, which can trigger safety failures during execution. Existing benchmarks mostly focus on endpoint outcome evaluation or model-assisted moderation of pre-constructed trajectories, leaving limited evidence about where risks enter and how they propagate. To address this issue, we introduce TraceProbe, an execution-based benchmark for agent safety diagnosis. TraceProbe places agents in executable sandbox scenarios, scores endpoint and latent rule violations based on normalized traces and structured evidence, and replays recorded tool actions for step-level risk localization. Our benchmark contains 155 scenarios across three risk-source categories: non-adversarial failures, internal authority compromise, and external attacks. Across 12 contemporary LLMs, the mean attack success rate (ASR) is 0.347, indicating substantial residual risk, especially under internal authority compromise. Our analysis also demonstrates that endpoint-safe runs can contain unsafe intermediate actions, and the actual execution paths of agents may differ from the intended hazards of the testing scenarios. The TraceProbe benchmark and our findings support a more actionable form of agent safety evaluation: beyond assessing ASR or final outcomes, evaluators can also ask what went wrong, where it occurred, and where an intervention could be placed.

core.title: TRACE-GRPO: Teacher-Refined Advantage Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
core.abstract: Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to post-train LLM agents, but its trajectory-level advantage is ill-suited to long-horizon credit assignment. Reward-homogeneous rollout groups yield zero advantage; otherwise, one scalar uniformly scales every token, obscuring which decisions determine the outcome. We propose **TRACE-GRPO** (**T**eacher-**R**efined **A**dvantage **C**redit **E**stimation for GRPO), which converts teacher-LLM feedback into hierarchical credit. Teacher scores provide a sample-level fallback for zero-variance groups, reweight trajectory advantage at the turn level, and redistribute turn credit at the token level using the policy’s log-probability shift under a teacher critique. This yields dense training-time credit without token-level annotations or learned critics. We also introduce **CAPA** (Critique-Aware Paged Attention), which reuses trajectory KV caches and reduces the isolated critique-conditioned forward from roughly 2\times a vanilla GRPO step to approximately 5% of a training step. On ALFWorld and ScienceWorld with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TRACE-GRPO achieves 96.3% and 73.4% success, respectively, outperforming strong agent RL baselines. Ablations show cumulative gains from the three credit levels, and comparison with supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated successes confirms that critique-guided policy optimization provides benefits beyond imitation. Code is available at [https://github.com/Lau-Jonathan/TRACE-GRPO](https://github.com/Lau-Jonathan/TRACE-GRPO).

core.title_zh: TRACE-GRPO：面向长时程智能体强化学习的教师精炼优势信用估计

article.lead: 长程任务中的大语言模型智能体，如何判断哪些决策真正影响了最终结果？TRACE-GRPO 尝试利用教师模型反馈细化训练时的信用分配，为理解智能体强化学习提供了一个视角。

sections.title: 长程轨迹中的信用分配难题
paragraphs: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）广泛用于大语言模型智能体的后训练，但摘要指出，轨迹级优势信号并不适合长程信用分配：当一组采样轨迹的奖励相同时，优势为零；否则，同一个标量会统一缩放轨迹中所有 token，难以区分哪些决策决定了结果。

sections.title: 将教师反馈转化为分层信用
paragraphs: TRACE-GRPO 将教师大语言模型的反馈转化为分层信用。对于奖励方差为零的组，教师评分提供样本级的备用信号；在轮次级，教师评分重新加权轨迹优势；在 token 级，方法利用教师批评下策略对数概率的变化，将轮次信用重新分配给 token。
摘要称，这种设计无需 token 级标注或学习得到的评论器，就能提供训练时的密集信用信号。作者还提出批评感知分页注意力（CAPA），通过复用轨迹 KV 缓存，降低以教师批评为条件的独立前向计算开销。

sections.title: 任务成功率与计算开销
paragraphs: 摘要报告，使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 时，TRACE-GRPO 在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上分别达到 96.3% 和 73.4% 的成功率，优于较强的智能体强化学习基线。消融结果显示，样本、轮次和 token 三个信用层级带来了累积收益。
与在教师生成的成功轨迹上进行监督微调的比较表明，批评引导的策略优化带来了超出模仿的收益。摘要还称，CAPA 将独立的批评条件前向计算从约为普通 GRPO 一步的 2 倍，降至约为一个训练步骤的 5%。这一数字针对所述独立前向计算，不应直接理解为整体训练耗时的降幅。

sections.title: 摘要尚不能回答的验证范围
paragraphs: 摘要没有给出样本规模、具体基线名单、各层级的单独收益或结果波动，因此仅凭摘要无法判断比较的完整范围与统计稳定性。摘要也没有说明该方法在其他模型、任务或更广泛场景中的验证范围；这不等于论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：细看教师反馈如何作用
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对于关注大语言模型智能体的读者，可进一步查阅论文中教师评分、批评与各层级信用分配的具体关系，以及与监督微调的比较设置，从而理解结果在何种条件下支持“超出模仿”的判断。

core.title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
core.abstract: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains under-explored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. While individual cues can be circumvented by targeted prompting, a simple few-shot, training-free aggregator over these cues improves mean AUROC by +0.14 over the best existing detector across agentic settings. Our project is available on GitHub.
core.summary: 【摘要】论文关注大语言模型辅助填写在线调查对研究有效性的影响，提出覆盖多种使用策略的基准数据集 ASURRE，并将生成回答与真实人类回答配对。评估显示，模仿完整受访者的角色设定智能体使现有检测器表现接近随机，但其行为仍留下可辨识痕迹。作者据此采用无需训练的少样本线索聚合方法，在智能体场景下的平均 AUROC 比最佳现有检测器高 0.14。[摘要]

deep_read.method: 【摘要】作者构建 ASURRE 基准，覆盖完整生成、修订及基于角色设定的智能体作答等策略；使用多个大语言模型在不同学科的三项真实调查上生成回答，并与真实人类回答配对，再评估现有检测器及行为线索聚合方法。[摘要]

deep_read.findings: 【摘要】简单使用人工智能较易被现有检测器发现，而模仿完整受访者的智能体使检测性能接近随机。行为线索聚合方法在智能体场景下的平均 AUROC 比最佳现有检测器提高 0.14；摘要未给出各场景的具体结果。[摘要]
deep_read.limitations: 【摘要】单个行为线索可被针对性提示规避，说明线索本身并非可靠的固定判据；作者也将 ASURRE 称为“initial benchmark”。【本站解读】摘要未报告样本规模、统计显著性或跨场景泛化细节，不能据此判断这些方面的表现。[摘要]
deep_read.connection: 【本站解读】论文以行为线索补充文本检测的思路，可能启发可靠性研究中的异常行为识别；但在线调查作答与工程系统运行之间存在场景差异。当前资料未展示其在智能运维、结构设计或工程可靠性任务中的应用证据。[摘要]
deep_read.next_steps: 【建议】如需评估该方法的可迁移性，可先查阅全文中的行为线索定义、数据划分及各智能体场景结果，再考察针对性提示下的稳健性。若用于工程场景，还应单独验证数据条件和误报风险；这些均为研究建议，而非作者已证实的结论。[摘要]

core.title_zh: 面向在线调查中人工智能辅助回答的检测

article.lead: 大语言模型参与填写在线问卷，可能影响调查研究的有效性，但如何识别这种参与仍缺乏充分研究。本文通过一个初步基准考察不同使用策略，也提示读者：识别单段生成文本与识别模拟完整受访者的智能体，并不是同一个难题。

sections.title: 当大模型成为问卷填写者
paragraphs: 在线问卷依赖受访者的回答开展研究，而大语言模型可以参与生成或修改回答。随着参与方式从直接生成扩展到模拟受访者，调查数据中人类作答与模型辅助作答的区分也变得值得关注。
论文聚焦 AI 辅助参与问卷的识别问题，提出初步基准数据集 ASURRE。它覆盖从完整生成、修改到基于人物设定的智能体填写等策略，为比较不同参与方式下的检测表现提供材料。

sections.title: 从参与策略构建 ASURRE 基准
paragraphs: 研究使用多个大语言模型，在不同学科的三个真实问卷上，按照不同使用策略生成模型辅助回答，并与真实人类回答配对。摘要将这些材料用于评估现有机器生成文本检测器。
除文本检测外，研究还关注智能体填写留下的受访者层面行为线索，并采用一种简单的少样本、无需训练的聚合器整合这些线索。摘要没有展开聚合器的具体实现。

sections.title: 模拟完整受访者让检测更难
paragraphs: 摘要报告，直接使用 AI 的方式较容易被现有检测器识别；但当基于人物设定的智能体试图模仿完整受访者时，检测器表现趋近于随机水平。这个对比说明，检测效果会随模型参与策略而变化。
研究同时发现，智能体填写不能完全复制受访者层面的行为，仍会留下有辨识度的行为痕迹。单个线索可以通过针对性提示被绕过，但在智能体设置下，线索聚合器的平均 AUROC 比表现最好的现有检测器提高了 +0.14。

sections.title: 摘要尚未交代的样本与验证边界
paragraphs: 摘要没有给出人类受访者和回答的具体样本量、各模型及问卷的详细构成，也未列明受试检测器和行为线索的完整清单，因此无法仅凭摘要判断比较是否覆盖了所有相关场景。
摘要也未说明结果在其他问卷、人群或模型上的验证范围，以及聚合器在不同条件下的具体表现。这些是当前资料的阅读边界，不能据此认定论文没有开展相关分析。

papers.title: Trust Cascade through Provenance Erasure: How Multi-Agent Delegation Breaks Single-Agent Safety
papers.abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems delegate through natural language, creating trust boundaries that single-agent safety hierarchies were not designed to preserve. We identify provenance erasure as a multi-agent safety failure mechanism: even in the minimal two-agent case, delegation strips trust metadata—98% of format markers, 100% of authority entities, and 44% of source attribution across 460 pairs—while often preserving the actionable payload. This lossy transform enables Trust Cascade, amplifying system-channel attacks from 0% to 33–63% cascade ASR across eight open-weight models; a delegation-as-user control isolates channel trust escalation rather than content reformulation. Because the failure occurs at the delegation boundary, we propose the Trust Boundary Auditor (TBA), a zero-inference provenance diagnostic achieving 86–100% conditional detection with 0% false positives across four domains. Training, scale, and closed-source evaluations show that stronger models can interrupt different cascade stages but do not remove the boundary problem, suggesting that multi-agent safety requires delegation gating plus provenance auditing.
papers.summary: 【论文摘要】论文研究大语言模型多智能体系统在自然语言委派中面临的信任边界问题。作者提出“来源信息抹除”机制：委派可能丢失信任元数据，却保留可执行内容，从而引发信任级联。摘要报告了双智能体数据、八个开源权重模型上的攻击结果，以及零推理来源诊断方法 TBA 的检测结果。作者据此提出结合委派门控与来源审计；实验细节及其适用边界仍需全文核对。[摘要]

deep_read.method: 【论文摘要】作者分析最小双智能体场景中的委派信息变化，并在八个开源权重模型上评估级联攻击；同时设置“delegation-as-user”对照，以区分通道信任升级与内容改写的作用。摘要还提出零推理来源诊断方法 TBA。[摘要]

papers.title_zh: 来源信息抹除引发的信任级联：多智能体委派如何破坏单智能体安全机制

article.lead: 多智能体通过自然语言委派任务时，信息来源与权限可能在传递中丢失。本文从委派边界切入，揭示这种损失如何放大安全攻击，并讨论来源审计的价值。

sections.title: 任务委派为何形成新的信任边界
paragraphs: 单智能体安全层级并非为保护多智能体之间的信任边界而设计。任务经自然语言转交时，接收方看到的内容可能保留了可执行的指令，却不再完整携带其来源和权限信息。
摘要将这一机制称为**来源擦除**：问题不只是内容发生改写，还在于内容跨越委派边界后，原有的信任信息可能不再可见。

sections.title: 从双智能体委派到边界审计
paragraphs: 研究考察了最简双智能体委派中的信任元数据损失，并通过将委派内容作为用户消息的对照，区分通道信任升级与内容重新表述的作用。
针对委派边界处的失效，作者提出信任边界审计器（TBA），将其作为无需推理的来源诊断方法。摘要没有展开该审计器的具体实现。

sections.title: 来源擦除与信任级联的报告结果
paragraphs: 在 460 对数据中，委派过程剥离了 98% 的格式标记、100% 的权威实体和 44% 的来源归属，同时往往保留可执行的载荷。摘要据此指出，有损传递使“信任级联”成为可能。
在八个开放权重模型上，系统通道攻击从 0% 放大至 33–63% 的级联攻击成功率。将委派内容作为用户消息的对照表明，关键作用来自通道信任升级，而非内容重新表述。
TBA 在四个领域取得 86–100% 的条件检测率，误报率为 0%。训练、规模和闭源评估还显示，更强模型能够中断级联的不同阶段，但并未消除边界问题。

sections.title: 摘要尚不能界定的评估范围
paragraphs: 摘要没有说明数据对的具体构成、各领域的样本分布，也未完整列出比较对象、模型及评估条件。因此，不能仅凭摘要判断结果对其他任务、系统或攻击形式的适用范围。
摘要同样未交代 TBA 的详细实现、条件检测率的具体条件及独立验证范围；这些信息需要查阅论文后才能判断，而不能据此认定论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：关注信息如何跨越委派边界
paragraphs: 对于大语言模型多智能体系统，阅读启发是同时关注消息内容与其来源、权限在委派中的变化。进一步阅读时，可重点核对用户消息对照如何设置，以及 TBA 在什么条件下作出检测。
摘要提出将委派门控与来源审计结合起来，但没有报告二者结合后的具体验证效果。理解这一建议的适用边界，还需要查看论文中的评估细节。

papers.title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
papers.abstract: Personalized large language models adapt responses to users’ preferences and social attributes, but can introduce substantial universal truth inconsistencies across social groups, where some groups systematically receive less accurate responses on objective tasks. Existing alignment methods either ignore personalization or mainly focus on subjective preference alignment, largely overlooking fairness and consistency in universal truths. To address this gap, we study Truth-Invariant Alignment (TIA), an alignment problem for personalized LLMs that aims to ensure universal truths remain consistent across social groups while preserving personalization. We propose TriAlign, the first offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework for TIA, where each social group is modeled as an agent interacting. TriAlign jointly optimizes universal truth accuracy, cross-group truth consistency, and personalization through a fairness-aware objective and an explicit inconsistency penalty. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that TriAlign achieves a stronger balance among these three objectives than strong baselines, reducing universal truth disparities across social groups while improving both objective task performance and personalization quality.

papers.title: TRACES: Proactive Safety Auditing for Multi-Turn LLM Agents via Trajectory-State Modeling
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly operate through multi-turn tool use and environment interaction, where safety risks often emerge from intermediate steps long before they surface in the final outcome. Reactive auditing is therefore insufficient: post-hoc diagnosis frequently misses the chance to flag risks while they are unfolding. We propose TRACES, a representation-based proactive auditor that learns prefix-level trajectory risk states from the hidden representations of an observer LLM. TRACES induces latent mechanism features from step representations and models their temporal evolution to estimate whether a partial trajectory is drifting toward unsafe behavior. To sidestep the cost and ambiguity of step-level risk annotation, TRACES is trained with weak trajectory-level supervision while still producing dense prefix-level risk estimates. Across multiple agent safety benchmarks, TRACES improves both full-trajectory safety prediction and proactive risk discrimination. Our analyses further suggest that these risk states can help train a safer agent, highlighting the broader potential of proactive auditing for long-horizon agent safety. The code is available at https://github.com/lab-flair/TRACES.

papers.title: TraceProbe: An Execution-Based Benchmark for Diagnosing Safety Failures in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly act through files, tools, memory, retrieved content, and other agents, which can trigger safety failures during execution. Existing benchmarks mostly focus on endpoint outcome evaluation or model-assisted moderation of pre-constructed trajectories, leaving limited evidence about where risks enter and how they propagate. To address this issue, we introduce TraceProbe, an execution-based benchmark for agent safety diagnosis. TraceProbe places agents in executable sandbox scenarios, scores endpoint and latent rule violations based on normalized traces and structured evidence, and replays recorded tool actions for step-level risk localization. Our benchmark contains 155 scenarios across three risk-source categories: non-adversarial failures, internal authority compromise, and external attacks. Across 12 contemporary LLMs, the mean attack success rate (ASR) is 0.347, indicating substantial residual risk, especially under internal authority compromise. Our analysis also demonstrates that endpoint-safe runs can contain unsafe intermediate actions, and the actual execution paths of agents may differ from the intended hazards of the testing scenarios. The TraceProbe benchmark and our findings support a more actionable form of agent safety evaluation: beyond assessing ASR or final outcomes, evaluators can also ask what went wrong, where it occurred, and where an intervention could be placed.

papers.title_zh: TraceProbe：基于执行的智能体安全失效诊断基准

article.lead: 大语言模型智能体的最终输出看似安全，执行过程中却可能出现风险。TraceProbe尝试通过可执行场景与轨迹分析，让安全评估进一步回答风险发生在哪里。

sections.title: 只看最终结果，可能漏掉执行风险
paragraphs: 大语言模型智能体正越来越多地通过文件、工具、记忆、检索内容及其他智能体采取行动。这些交互使安全问题不再只关乎最后给出的答案，也可能出现在执行过程之中。
摘要指出，现有基准主要关注终点结果评估，或借助模型审查预先构建的轨迹；对于风险从哪里进入、又如何传播，能够提供的证据仍然有限。

sections.title: 在沙箱中执行，并回放工具动作
paragraphs: TraceProbe是一个基于执行的智能体安全诊断基准。它将智能体置于可执行的沙箱场景中，依据规范化轨迹和结构化证据，对终点及潜在的规则违反情况评分，并回放记录的工具动作，以定位步骤层面的风险。
该基准包含155个场景，覆盖三类风险来源：非对抗性失误、内部权威受损和外部攻击。这一分类把并非由外部攻击直接引起的风险也纳入了评估视野。

sections.title: 终点安全不等于过程安全
paragraphs: 在12个当代大语言模型上，摘要报告的平均攻击成功率（ASR）为0.347。作者据此认为仍存在显著残余风险，尤其是在内部权威受损的情况下。
分析还发现，终点安全的运行可能包含不安全的中间动作；智能体的实际执行路径，也可能与测试场景预期的危险不同。因此，仅凭最终结果不一定能说明执行过程中发生了什么。

sections.title: 摘要尚不能说明的评估范围
paragraphs: 摘要给出了场景与模型数量，但未交代场景的具体构成、模型选择细节及各类场景的分布，也不足以判断这些样本能在多大程度上代表实际应用。
摘要未说明与其他基准的具体比较结果，也未详细报告评分、风险定位及跨场景使用的验证范围。这些信息需要进一步查阅论文，不能据此断言相关工作没有开展。

sections.title: 阅读启发：从结果追问风险位置
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对于使用工具或检索内容的大模型智能体，安全评估除了关注最终是否达成攻击目标，也值得追问中间发生了什么、风险出现在哪里，以及何处可能设置干预。
进一步阅读时，可留意规范化轨迹、结构化证据与工具动作回放如何共同支持诊断，并核对这些诊断结论的适用范围。摘要提出的是更具操作性的评估方向，并未证明具体干预已经有效。

papers.title: TRACE-GRPO: Teacher-Refined Advantage Credit Estimation for Long-Horizon Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used to post-train LLM agents, but its trajectory-level advantage is ill-suited to long-horizon credit assignment. Reward-homogeneous rollout groups yield zero advantage; otherwise, one scalar uniformly scales every token, obscuring which decisions determine the outcome. We propose **TRACE-GRPO** (**T**eacher-**R**efined **A**dvantage **C**redit **E**stimation for GRPO), which converts teacher-LLM feedback into hierarchical credit. Teacher scores provide a sample-level fallback for zero-variance groups, reweight trajectory advantage at the turn level, and redistribute turn credit at the token level using the policy’s log-probability shift under a teacher critique. This yields dense training-time credit without token-level annotations or learned critics. We also introduce **CAPA** (Critique-Aware Paged Attention), which reuses trajectory KV caches and reduces the isolated critique-conditioned forward from roughly 2\times a vanilla GRPO step to approximately 5% of a training step. On ALFWorld and ScienceWorld with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, TRACE-GRPO achieves 96.3% and 73.4% success, respectively, outperforming strong agent RL baselines. Ablations show cumulative gains from the three credit levels, and comparison with supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated successes confirms that critique-guided policy optimization provides benefits beyond imitation. Code is available at [https://github.com/Lau-Jonathan/TRACE-GRPO](https://github.com/Lau-Jonathan/TRACE-GRPO).
papers.summary: 【论文摘要】本文针对 GRPO 在长时程智能体任务中难以定位关键决策的问题，提出 TRACE-GRPO，利用教师语言模型反馈，在样本、轮次和词元三个层级分配训练信用，并以 CAPA 复用轨迹 KV 缓存以降低相关前向计算开销。在摘要报告的两个环境中，该方法优于所比较的智能体强化学习基线；具体实验设置和结果适用范围仍需查阅全文。[摘要]

papers.title_zh: TRACE-GRPO：面向长时程智能体强化学习的教师精炼优势信用估计

article.lead: 长程任务中的大语言模型智能体，如何判断哪些决策真正影响了最终结果？TRACE-GRPO 尝试利用教师模型反馈细化训练时的信用分配，为理解智能体强化学习提供了一个视角。

sections.title: 长程轨迹中的信用分配难题
paragraphs: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）广泛用于大语言模型智能体的后训练，但摘要指出，轨迹级优势信号并不适合长程信用分配：当一组采样轨迹的奖励相同时，优势为零；否则，同一个标量会统一缩放轨迹中所有 token，难以区分哪些决策决定了结果。

sections.title: 将教师反馈转化为分层信用
paragraphs: TRACE-GRPO 将教师大语言模型的反馈转化为分层信用。对于奖励方差为零的组，教师评分提供样本级的备用信号；在轮次级，教师评分重新加权轨迹优势；在 token 级，方法利用教师批评下策略对数概率的变化，将轮次信用重新分配给 token。
摘要称，这种设计无需 token 级标注或学习得到的评论器，就能提供训练时的密集信用信号。作者还提出批评感知分页注意力（CAPA），通过复用轨迹 KV 缓存，降低以教师批评为条件的独立前向计算开销。

sections.title: 任务成功率与计算开销
paragraphs: 摘要报告，使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 时，TRACE-GRPO 在 ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 上分别达到 96.3% 和 73.4% 的成功率，优于较强的智能体强化学习基线。消融结果显示，样本、轮次和 token 三个信用层级带来了累积收益。
与在教师生成的成功轨迹上进行监督微调的比较表明，批评引导的策略优化带来了超出模仿的收益。摘要还称，CAPA 将独立的批评条件前向计算从约为普通 GRPO 一步的 2 倍，降至约为一个训练步骤的 5%。这一数字针对所述独立前向计算，不应直接理解为整体训练耗时的降幅。

sections.title: 摘要尚不能回答的验证范围
paragraphs: 摘要没有给出样本规模、具体基线名单、各层级的单独收益或结果波动，因此仅凭摘要无法判断比较的完整范围与统计稳定性。摘要也没有说明该方法在其他模型、任务或更广泛场景中的验证范围；这不等于论文没有开展相关工作。

sections.title: 阅读启发：细看教师反馈如何作用
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对于关注大语言模型智能体的读者，可进一步查阅论文中教师评分、批评与各层级信用分配的具体关系，以及与监督微调的比较设置，从而理解结果在何种条件下支持“超出模仿”的判断。

papers.title: Towards Detecting AI-Assisted Responses in Online Surveys
papers.abstract: The use of LLMs to complete online surveys impacts the validity of survey-based research, but detecting such usage remains under-explored. We introduce an initial benchmark dataset, namely ASURRE, for AI-assisted survey participation to capture usage strategies ranging from full generation and revision to persona-grounded agentic completion. Controlled by these strategies, LLM-assisted survey responses are generated using multiple LLMs on three real-world surveys in different disciplines, paired with genuine human responses. Our evaluation of existing machine-generated text (MGT) detectors shows that naive AI usage is readily detectable, whereas persona-grounded agents that mimic entire respondents push detector performance toward chance. We further show that agentic completion cannot fully replicate respondent-level behaviour and leaves distinctive behavioural traces. While individual cues can be circumvented by targeted prompting, a simple few-shot, training-free aggregator over these cues improves mean AUROC by +0.14 over the best existing detector across agentic settings. Our project is available on GitHub.
papers.summary: 【摘要】论文关注大语言模型辅助填写在线调查对研究有效性的影响，提出覆盖多种使用策略的基准数据集 ASURRE，并将生成回答与真实人类回答配对。评估显示，模仿完整受访者的角色设定智能体使现有检测器表现接近随机，但其行为仍留下可辨识痕迹。作者据此采用无需训练的少样本线索聚合方法，在智能体场景下的平均 AUROC 比最佳现有检测器高 0.14。[摘要]

papers.title_zh: 面向在线调查中人工智能辅助回答的检测

article.lead: 大语言模型参与填写在线问卷，可能影响调查研究的有效性，但如何识别这种参与仍缺乏充分研究。本文通过一个初步基准考察不同使用策略，也提示读者：识别单段生成文本与识别模拟完整受访者的智能体，并不是同一个难题。

sections.title: 当大模型成为问卷填写者
paragraphs: 在线问卷依赖受访者的回答开展研究，而大语言模型可以参与生成或修改回答。随着参与方式从直接生成扩展到模拟受访者，调查数据中人类作答与模型辅助作答的区分也变得值得关注。
论文聚焦 AI 辅助参与问卷的识别问题，提出初步基准数据集 ASURRE。它覆盖从完整生成、修改到基于人物设定的智能体填写等策略，为比较不同参与方式下的检测表现提供材料。

sections.title: 从参与策略构建 ASURRE 基准
paragraphs: 研究使用多个大语言模型，在不同学科的三个真实问卷上，按照不同使用策略生成模型辅助回答，并与真实人类回答配对。摘要将这些材料用于评估现有机器生成文本检测器。
除文本检测外，研究还关注智能体填写留下的受访者层面行为线索，并采用一种简单的少样本、无需训练的聚合器整合这些线索。摘要没有展开聚合器的具体实现。

sections.title: 模拟完整受访者让检测更难
paragraphs: 摘要报告，直接使用 AI 的方式较容易被现有检测器识别；但当基于人物设定的智能体试图模仿完整受访者时，检测器表现趋近于随机水平。这个对比说明，检测效果会随模型参与策略而变化。
研究同时发现，智能体填写不能完全复制受访者层面的行为，仍会留下有辨识度的行为痕迹。单个线索可以通过针对性提示被绕过，但在智能体设置下，线索聚合器的平均 AUROC 比表现最好的现有检测器提高了 +0.14。

sections.title: 摘要尚未交代的样本与验证边界
paragraphs: 摘要没有给出人类受访者和回答的具体样本量、各模型及问卷的详细构成，也未列明受试检测器和行为线索的完整清单，因此无法仅凭摘要判断比较是否覆盖了所有相关场景。
摘要也未说明结果在其他问卷、人群或模型上的验证范围，以及聚合器在不同条件下的具体表现。这些是当前资料的阅读边界，不能据此认定论文没有开展相关分析。

sections.title: 阅读启发：从文本转向作答行为
paragraphs: 阅读启发：对于关注大语言模型的读者，可以进一步查阅论文如何定义受访者层面的行为线索，以及这些线索与文本检测结果如何互补；同时留意针对性提示为何能够绕过单个线索。
